title: The homogeneous module coproduct of a line bundle symmetric algebra
statement: For a scheme X and an invertible O_X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module], fix a commutative algebra sheaf B [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], a map j:L to U(B), and maps b_d:L.tensorPow d to U(B). Assume that on every affine open U there is a ring equivalence Sym_{O(U)}(L(U)) to B(U), compatible with the structure map and j [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. Assume b_0 is the structure map, b_1 is the right unitor followed by j, and the b_d respect tensor-power multiplication [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Then the cofan with vertex U(B) and legs b_d is a coproduct in X.Modules.

source.place: Section 01CF and Lemma 01CG; schemes.tex Section 01LA (9); coherent.tex Tag 09MS, the direct-sum algebra

proof.text: On each affine open U let H be the additive subgroup generated by all images b_d(s). Multiplicativity makes products of generators generators. AddSubgroup.closure_induction₂ and distributivity therefore show H is closed under multiplication. The affine comparison sends algebra scalars to b_0 and degree-one generators to b_1 after the inverse right unitor. SymmetricAlgebra.induction gives H = B(U). This proves additive generation without any choice of a frame. The Lean local fact is hgen.

source.place: SymmetricAlgebra.induction; AddSubgroup.closure_induction₂; both inductions are implemented directly in Lean

proof.text: Maps out of B agreeing after every b_d agree on the generators of H. AddMonoidHom.eqOn_closure gives agreement on every affine section by Step 1. Cover any open by its affine subopens and apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' after naturality of the two module maps. Thus they agree globally. Empty opens are handled by sheaf separation for the empty cover. The Lean local fact is hext.

source.place: TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq', applied to the cover of an open by affine subopens

proof.text: Prove the affine finite-sum map DirectSum.toModule b is injective. First work on an affine V with free generator g of L. Transfer g through the inverse right unitor to degree one, and recursively tensor frames using tensorPowAddIso d 1. IsFreeGenerator.tmulSection and IsFreeGenerator.app_hom prove each degree has a frame. The singleton basis with vector g identifies Sym(L(V)) with a one-variable polynomial ring by SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial and MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv. The affine comparison sends the structure map to C and j(g) to X. Induction with hZero, hOne and hMul sends the degree-d frame to X^d, hence sends b_d(s) to monomial d (coeff s), by linearity. DirectSum.induction_on proves that the degree-d coefficient of any finite sum is exactly the coefficient of its d-th tensor component. Equality of polynomial coefficients and injectivity of frame coefficients prove injectivity on V. For an arbitrary affine U, define coefficientwise restriction of finite sums using DirectSum.toAddMonoid; induction proves its component formula and commutation with the finite-sum map. IsInvertible.sheafOfModules_isInvertible and exists_isFreeGenerator give framed affine neighbourhoods of each point inside U. Apply the framed injectivity to the restricted sums and then TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.section_ext to each tensor component. This proves injectivity on U. The Lean local fact is hinj; no globally chosen trivialization is assumed.

source.place: Section 01CF, the tensor and symmetric algebra construction; equivMvPolynomial; IsFreeGenerator.coeff and exists_isFreeGenerator; IsInvertible.sheafOfModules_isInvertible

proof.text: The range of the affine finite-sum map is an additive subgroup containing every homogeneous image, so Step 1 gives surjectivity. Combine it with Step 3 in LinearEquiv.ofBijective. For an arbitrary target M and maps c_d, compose DirectSum.toModule c with the inverse equivalence to obtain a linear localMap U on every affine U. DirectSum.toModule_lof proves localMap U b_d = c_d. For nested affine opens, naturality of b_d and c_d gives compatibility on the homogeneous images; AddMonoidHom.eqOn_closure and Step 1 extend compatibility to every section. Bundle these maps as a natural transformation on the affine basis. TopCat.Sheaf.restrictHomEquivHom extends it to an additive presheaf map into M; extend_hom_app supplies its affine components. Check linearity by restricting to affine subopens, using PresheafOfModules.map_smul and affine linearity, and applying sheaf separation. Package the resulting map using PresheafOfModules.homMk. The same affine-cover argument proves its factorization through every b_d. The Lean local fact is hexists. Only affine sections are expressed as finite sums; no finite-support formula is asserted for arbitrary opens.

source.place: DirectSum.toModule and toModule_lof; TopCat.Sheaf.restrictHomEquivHom and extend_hom_app

proof.text: For every cofan choose the extension from hexists, whose value is uniquely determined by hext. Its factorization is choose_spec. Apply Cofan.IsColimit.mk with these maps and equations. For uniqueness, a competing map has the same composites with every b_d as the chosen extension, so hext identifies them. This is the complete Lean construction of Nonempty IsColimit.

proof_origin.place: Section 01CF tensor/symmetric algebra route, fully implemented with affine polynomial coefficients and basis morphism extension; no new sorry or axiom.

lean.statement: theorem isColimit_invertible_symmetricAlgebra_cofan {X : Scheme.{u}} (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (B : X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (j : L ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B) (b : ∀ d : ℕ, L.tensorPow d ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B) (hAffine : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, ∃ e : SymmetricAlgebra (X.presheaf.obj (op U.1)) (L.val.obj (op U.1)) ≃+* B.right.obj.obj (op U.1), (∀ r : X.presheaf.obj (op U.1), e (algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (op U.1)) (SymmetricAlgebra (X.presheaf.obj (op U.1)) (L.val.obj (op U.1))) r) = B.hom.hom.app (op U.1) r) ∧ (∀ x : L.val.obj (op U.1), e (SymmetricAlgebra.ι (X.presheaf.obj (op U.1)) (L.val.obj (op U.1)) x) = j.val.app (op U.1) x)) (hZero : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)), (b 0).app U (unitSectionsEquiv U r) = B.hom.hom.app (op U) r) (hOne : b 1 = (ρ_ L).hom ≫ j) (hMul : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a d : ℕ) (s : Γ(L.tensorPow a, U)) (t : Γ(L.tensorPow d, U)), (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b a).app U s) * (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b d).app U t) = (show B.right.obj.obj (op U) from (b (a + d)).app U ((L.tensorPowAddIso a d).inv.app U (tmulSection s t)))) : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B) b))
